remarks: Ideally situated in a sought-after Stamford neighborhood, 125 Oaklawn Avenue offers a rare opportunity to create something special. Set on a well-maintained property, this home features sun-filled interiors and a comfortable flow for everyday living. The kitchen opens to the dining and living rooms, while the second floor includes three bedrooms and one full bath. A spacious, level backyard provides ample room for entertaining, relaxing, or future possibilities. Just minutes from Stamford's vibrant downtown, train, parks, and beaches, this property offers exceptional convenience and lifestyle appeal. Whether restoring the existing home to its former glory or starting fresh, the potential here is undeniable. Home is being sold as is.
